messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Polish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Polish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
I do niego poeto błagam cię przez tego boga którego nie znałeś, abym mógł uciec od tego zła i gorszego,

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Polish → English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | **E** | discourse connector “and” | **I** | “and” | OK | | **io** (1st) | speaker, subject of “richiedo” | *(none – implied)* | “I” | **MISSING** | | **a** | preposition “to” (marks addressee) | **do** | “to” | OK | | **lui** | masculine addressee (indirect object) | **niego** | “him” | OK | | **Poeta** | vocative title “Poet” | **poeto** | “Poet” (vocative) | OK | | **io** (2nd) | speaker, subject of “richiedo” | *(none – implied)* | “I” | **MISSING** | | **ti** | second‑person object “you” | **cię** | “you” (acc.) | OK | | **richeggio** | verb “beseech” (present) | **błagam** | “I beseech” | OK | | **per** | preposition “by/through” (instrument) | **przez** | “by” | OK | | **quello** | demonstrative “that” (specifies God) | **tego** | “that” | OK | | **Dio** | noun “God” (specific deity) | **boga** | “God” (gen.) | OK | | **che** | relative pronoun “whom/that” | **którego** | “whom/that” (gen.) | OK | | **tu** | second‑person subject of relative clause | *(none – implied)* | “you” | **MISSING** | | **non** | negation particle | **nie** | “not” | OK | | **conoscesti** | verb “knew” (past, negative) | **znałeś** | “you knew” | OK | | **acciò** | purpose conjunction “in order that” | **abym** | “so that I may” | OK | | **ch'io** | conjunction + subject “that I” | *(none – incorporated in “abym”)* | “that I” | **MISSING** | | **fuga** | verb “escape” (subjunctive) | **uciec** | “to escape” | OK | | **questo** | demonstrative “this” (object of escape) | **tego** | “this” (gen.) | OK | | **male** | noun “ill, evil” | **zła** | “evil” (gen.) | OK | | **e** | coordinating conjunction “and” | **i** | “and” | OK | | **peggio** | comparative adjective “worse” | **gorszego** | “worse” (gen.) | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING**: 1. **io** (first occurrence) – subject of the opening clause. 2. **io** (second occurrence) – subject of “richeggio”. 3. **tu** – subject of the relative clause “you did not know”. 4. **ch'io** – conjunction + subject “that I” (absorbed into “abym” in Polish).
No **GRAMMAR**, **WRONG**, or **UNNECESSARY** entries were identified.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Polish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Polish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 1** - Original: I do niego poeto błagam cię - Issue: missing subject **io**; the initial “I” is English, not Polish. - Corrected: **Ja do niego poeto błagam cię**
- **Line 2** - Original: przez tego boga którego nie znałeś, - Issue: missing subject **tu** in the relative clause. - Corrected: **przez tego boga którego ty nie znałeś,**
- **Line 3** - Original: abym mógł uciec od tego zła i gorszego, - Issue: missing subject **io** and missing **ch'io** (“that I”). - Corrected: **abym ja mógł uciec od tego zła i gorszego,**
```polish Ja do niego poeto błagam cię przez tego boga którego ty nie znałeś, abym ja mógł uciec od tego zła i gorszego, ```
